$comment: The source of sf-button-icon's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/icon-button (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

kind.summary: What the icon button is: an ordinary icon action or a close control.

size.summary: The icon size and the control's step on the ladder: 1 by default. Beside a value in a line of text, give it the line's step (size="1/2" beside text 1/2: 32, icon 20; size 1 beside text 1: 40, icon 24); in a row of buttons or a field it takes their size; density moves it with the row (decision C103).

height.summary: The control height (owner decisions C27, C35), as on sf-button: size sets the icon and the inner scale, height picks the control height from the size's tightness steps -- low, default, high, highest, the size's usual step and its neighbours on the UI height ladder. The button stays square: the step is the padding on all four sides. Desktop 1/3 24/28/32/40, 1/2 28/32/40/48, 1 32/40/48/56, 2 40/48/56/68, 3 48/56/68/80; phone 1/3 20/24/28/36, 1/2 24/28/36/44, 1 28/36/44/52, 2 36/44/52/64, 3 44/52/64/76. A compact region (data-sf-density) shifts the steps one down. kind="close" takes the same heights. A value outside the list reads as default.

appearance.summary: How the icon button looks, one ladder from the strongest (rule C15): default (filled), tonal, outline, ghost (no fill or edge until a pointer or the keyboard reaches it), and plain (owner decision C201): no fill or edge in any state, only the glyph's ink moves -- on-surface-variant at rest, on-surface under the pointer, primary on a press -- for an icon inside another element (a field's action, the help mark at a heading, copy in a code block); a plain icon button is neutral whatever the scheme or the status say. link is ghost's former name; surface was retired and is drawn as tonal with the on-surface scheme. A danger icon button is default, outline or ghost (rule C116): tonal and surface with status danger draw as outline until 2027-01-01, with one console warning.

scheme.summary: Which colour family the control takes (rule C15): primary, on-surface (the neutral, the text colour) or on-surface-variant (the quiet neutral: a window's head, a table row, a field's clear; under a pointer its glyph darkens to on-surface). A filled (default) control keeps on-surface's inverse glyph with on-surface-variant: on a dark fill there is no quieter step. secondary was retired and is drawn as on-surface-variant. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

status.summary: What the control is about (rule C13): danger, a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone. It paints with the error roles -- the red of an error -- and behaves exactly like a primary control. error is its former name on a control. danger is the only status of an icon button (rule C116): there are no success, warning or info icon buttons; another word draws no status and warns once per page.

segment.summary: Joined-control position owned by Button Group composition.

filled.summary: Use the filled glyph axis for the standard icon variant.

spacing.summary: Retired (owner decision C213, 2026-11-16): an icon button has no density; size and height change it and keep it square. Read and noted until 2027-01-01, it draws nothing.

loading.summary: Loading state: the spinner in place of the icon, at the icon's size, in the page's look (data-sf-spinner). Sets aria-busy and disables the native button.

href.summary: An address: the icon button draws a link (an <a href>) with its look, as sf-button's href (decision C51: the quiet «Скачать <name>» at the end of a table row is a real link to the file). A relative address, a fragment, http(s), mailto or tel; any other scheme draws a button. native-type, pressed and a cycle do not apply; disabled or loading, the link has no href and says aria-disabled. The name is the aria-label, as on the button.

target.summary: Where a link (href) opens, as an <a target>: _blank opens a new tab. Not written on a button.

rel.summary: The link's relation, as an <a rel>. A link that opens in a new tab (target _blank) with no rel says noopener noreferrer. Not written on a button.

download.summary: A link (href) that downloads its file, as an <a download>: the name it is saved under, or present and empty for the server's name. Not written on a button.

badge-count.summary: A count on the icon button (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon button's accessible name («Уведомления, 5 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

badge-dot.summary: A dot on the icon button, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

badge-cap.summary: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

badge-label.summary: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

button-attributes.summary: Attributes an external project template may put on its button; the built-in template does not read them

pressed.summary: Whether this toggle button is on: aria-pressed on the native button and the pressed look -- the primary container fill, its ink, no visible edge and the icon filled (rule C12), on a toggle: outline or ghost in the neutral scheme (owner decision C211 (1)), and a filled (default) button of any scheme at its scheme's pressed step, its own ink and the icon filled (owner decision C309 (2)); another look keeps its own with aria-pressed and the console says once that it is no toggle; one choice among several is sf-segmented. pressed="false" says off; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said

label-pressed.summary: The accessible name while the toggle is on, for a toggle whose name changes («Добавить в избранное» → «Убрать из избранного»). Set, the name says the state and aria-pressed is not written; the pressed look still follows pressed. Empty: aria-label stays the name and aria-pressed says the state

tooltip.summary: The icon button shows its name as a Framework tooltip by itself (owner decision C160 (1)): under a resting pointer after 0.5 s, at once on keyboard focus, on a long press by touch, below the button and flipping above at the window's bottom edge; Escape and a press hide it. The text is the name (aria-label, the pressed name of a toggle, a cycle's current and next value) or, when the page wrote one, the host's title, which then draws no browser tooltip of its own. The tooltip is made on the first hover, focus or long press, not before; a button whose page linked a tooltip of its own (data-tooltip) keeps that one. "off": no tooltip -- for a button whose name stands next to it, or one that opens its own explanation (the «?» of sf-help-mark).

lang.summary: The language the label is written in (BCP 47).

pressed.summary: Draws this item with the pressed look (the «on» values of repeat); no aria-pressed is said.

cycle.x-shape: ui-source src/smart/helpers/cycle.js cycleItems: the attribute takes JSON or value::label::flags|… (flags icon=<name>, pressed), the property a list; the items are shaped like sf-segmented's items
cycle.summary: One button, several values (rule D11d): the items {value, label, icon, pressed?} a press steps through, wrapping at the end. value is the current item. The name and the icon say the current value («Повтор: один трек»), the tooltip says the current and the next, and a polite live region says the new value after a press; change {previous, value, item} follows. Not a toggle: pressed and label-pressed are ignored beside it, with one console warning.

theme-cycle.summary: A ready theme switch over SF.Loader's theme (the contract of sf-segmented's theme-switch: themePreference, setTheme, sf-theme-change). Present and empty: three values, «as the system», light and dark, in the owner's order -- first the theme opposite to the visible one, then the other, then «as the system» (rule D11d); "light dark": two values, every press flips the visible theme. The icons are contrast, light_mode and dark_mode; the words are the page language's («Тема: светлая. Нажмите — тёмная»). cycle is ignored beside it.

value.summary: The current item of a cycle (its value); a press writes the next one. Read it from the attribute or from change: the value property keeps the settings object it has always given.

item.summary: The item now current: {value, label, icon, lang, pressed}.

change.summary: A cycle (cycle or theme-cycle) moved to its next value after a person's press; dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed, after press on sf-button. A theme cycle sends it after SF.Loader.setTheme has drawn the theme. Not sent by a button that is not a cycle.

relations.name: badges
$comment: The badge sheet places a count or a dot on the button (simai/ui-source#12).

relations.name: dot
$comment: A badge's dot is the Framework's one dot, .sf-dot (owner decision C185 (8)): the dot sheet.

relations.name: spinner
$comment: The spinner a loading icon button shows, fetched after the page is ready.

relations.name: tooltip
$comment: The tooltip controller and sheet the button's own name tooltip uses (C160 (1)), fetched on the first hover, focus or long press.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

name.$comment: A cycle's name is the aria-label and the current item's label («Повтор: один трек»); a theme cycle without one says «Тема: …» in the page language.

accessibility.$comment: With href (1.9.0) it is a native link, role link; Enter follows it and Space does not press it.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-button-icon for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: journal attribute-tightness-to-spacing; its words are spacing's value aliases below, spacing wins when both are given
journal value-icon-button-looks-c15 (rule C15): link and ghost drew the same; ghost is the name
journal value-icon-button-looks-c15 (rule C15): secondary was drawn only in the tonal look and read as the quiet neutral elsewhere
journal value-control-status-error-to-danger (rule C13): a control's destructive status is danger; messages keep error

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-button-icon; sf-icon-button is a subclass defined beside it until the date
an icon button has no density (size and height keep it square); read and noted, said once per button in the console, it draws nothing
rows.summary: Retired (owner decision C213): an icon button has no density; draws nothing until 2027-01-01.

x-summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics. Attributes it does not own go to the inner control; a `data-*` is moved there, not copied (the host is display: contents and has no box): select the inner button by it (`[data-action]`, `closest('sf-button-icon')` for the host), and read what was written on the host with `element.dataAttributes`.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: a11y-role: button, the native <button> the template draws (the host is display:contents). The name is the host's aria-label, passed to the native button with the badge phrase after it (§3.1, §4.8); an icon-only control has no other text.

key-effects: Tab reach. Enter and Space are the native button's own activation, not an effect of the closed list; the native click bubbles as before. No press event: the parts catalogue gives sf-icon-button none, and sf-button's press is the target the stands wrote for sf-button alone.

setter: setButtonAttributes is not an action (§4.4): button-attributes is a writable object setting (a property), and the method stays a helper that writes it; it no longer writes the object into an attribute.

legacy names: type -> appearance, variant -> kind and tightness -> spacing leave the settings and are dated setting aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); tightness's words are spacing's value aliases (low/high/highest -> compact/comfortable/spacious). ghost stays an appearance of its own here: the class sf-icon-button--ghost draws it.
badge-cap is a number with min 1; badge-count stays a string capped by badge-cap.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.

template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift). The host stays display:contents: geometry lives on > button.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (add, default primary) plus tonal and outline, the close kind, the error status, a count badge, loading, disabled and segments.
css-variables: the seven public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json the class sheet already reads (§6).

folder: icon-buttons takes the tag's name, icon-button (§3, §21, §16 item 16); the loader bundle is cl-icon-button, cl-icon-buttons is a Loader forward (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json) and smart/icon-buttons/js/icon-buttons.js a forwarding script (css/icon-buttons.css its sheet) until 2026-12-01 (change journal path-smart-icon-buttons-to-icon-button). The registry id follows the folder: smart.icon-button (smart.icon-buttons is its dated alias in the same record).
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: a minor (§4.10): the scheme value on-surface-variant is added, the same name and the same meaning sf-button 1.2.0 gave it -- the on-surface family one step quieter, the glyph in --sf-on-surface-variant. Until now that grey was reachable only by accident: every pair of appearance and scheme sets --sf-icon--color except the ones nobody wrote a rule for (secondary outside tonal), where the base colour showed through. The element carries sf-icon-button--on-surface beside the new class, so every on-surface rule (fill, edge, states) holds and one rule in the custom sheet quietens the glyph and a close control's cross; a filled control is left alone (:not(--default)).

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-button-icon (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.button-icon and the bundle cl-button-icon follow it. sf-icon-button stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-button-icon, sf-icon-button) (change journal tag-sf-icon-button-to-sf-button-icon, path-smart-icon-button-to-button-icon).

version 1.4.0: a minor (§4.10): the setting pressed is added (stage 1 of the component sets, duplication audit A-10), as on sf-button: present, aria-pressed on the native button and, while on, the active state of the icon-button class sheet; absent, nothing is said. A page that wrote aria-pressed on the host keeps it.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-06): the host's aria-label is watched, so a name changed after the first drawing reaches the native button (it was patched by updateDom but never observed: sf-language's trigger kept «Язык: Русский» after a choice). Nothing else changes.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-07): a minor (§4.10): the pressed look and the setting label-pressed (owner decision 2026-11-07, docs review R028, rule C12). A toggle that is on wears sf-icon-button--pressed instead of the active class: the primary container fill, no visible edge (the border keeps its width and is transparent over the fill, so the height does not move), the icon in --sf-on-primary-container and filled (FILL 1) -- two cues, not colour alone. Hover and press over it step the container; focus draws the ring; disabled wears the disabled look and keeps the filled icon. Public variables --sf-icon-button-pressed-background-color and --sf-icon-button-pressed-color colour the resting pressed look. label-pressed is the name while on, for a toggle whose name changes: aria-pressed is then not written.

version 1.5.1 (2026-11-07): a loading icon button's spinner draws its ring inside the icon's live area (docs review R027, owner decision C11; component.spinner 1.1.0): 20 of the 24 units, as the Material Symbol beside it, in the same icon box, so nothing around it moves; the first-paint snapshots are retaken. The settings are unchanged.

version 1.5.2 (2026-11-08): the reference describes the current component only (docs review rules D02, D03, msg-4ef7082c): the scheme words no longer cite another component's version and pressed names the rule, not a sheet's version; tightness, type and variant are listed under sf-button-icon in the change journal, so the reference shows them as former names, not as attributes. Tab, Enter and Space are the component's own key map now (they were a registry copy); the manifest lists the same three. Settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (§4.10; docs review R031, R033, R039; owner rules C13, C15, D11d). The looks are four without twins: appearance default, tonal, outline, ghost -- link is ghost's dated alias (both drew the same), surface is retired and drawn as tonal with the on-surface scheme unless the page names a scheme (the component reads the word and notes it: it changes two settings, which a value alias cannot); its tonal look also fixes surface with status error, which drew grey. scheme primary, on-surface, on-surface-variant -- secondary is a dated alias of on-surface-variant; a quiet glyph without a fill darkens to on-surface under a pointer. status danger for a control that deletes or cannot be undone, error its dated alias (C13: messages keep error; one red, the error roles); the native button carries sf-icon-button--danger and sf-icon-button--error, which the sheets and their consumers select. ghost is drawn by the link class the sheets already had, so nothing a consumer selects moves. cycle (a list of {value, label, icon, pressed?}), theme-cycle and value: one button, several values (D11d) -- the name and icon say the current value, the title the current and the next, a polite live region the new value; change {previous, value, item}; theme-cycle steps the opposite of the visible theme first, then the other, then «as the system» (contrast icon), or flips two themes. pressed and label-pressed are ignored beside a cycle, with one console warning.
version 1.7.0: one number above the unreleased 1.6.0 (the looks above) and 1.5.3 (a first-paint sheet list patch) it joins; nothing beyond them changes.

version 1.7.1 (2026-11-09): a patch. A changed icon is handed to the sf-icon inside (its icon attribute) instead of being written as the glyph's text: the text write took lit's markers out of sf-icon's drawing and left its icon attribute on the old name, so a button whose icon changed and which was then moved (appended elsewhere, or carried by sf-drawer) threw "Cannot set properties of null (setting 'data')" and could keep the old glyph. sf-icon now draws the name and asks the Loader for it. Settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged; probe button-icon-move.

version 1.7.2 (2026-11-10): a patch (R074). A cycle asks the Loader for every icon it can show when it is drawn (each item's icon, filled where the item is pressed; the theme icons for theme-cycle), and a toggle (pressed present, filled absent) for its icon in both forms: the names join the page's first icon request, so a press draws the next icon from the page's font instead of asking the service for a grown one (the icon stayed blank while it was built, up to ~30 s). Nothing drawn differently; settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-10): a minor (C35, the notice actions): the height setting, low, default, high or highest, as on sf-button (C27); the button stays square. It joins the unreleased 1.7.2 (R074, the icons a cycle or a toggle can show are asked for ahead) in one release; 1.7.2 never ships alone. Values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.8.1 (2026-11-10, C36 follow-up, accepted by DEV): a patch. A loading icon button keeps its scheme colour, as sf-button does since 1.12.0 (owner decision C36): the fill, the edge and the icon colour of the resting button; the spinner takes the icon colour and its background ring that colour at 16 % (DEV look call). It stays natively disabled and aria-busy. disabled and loading at once wears the disabled look: the template writes .disabled, and turning disabled on or off on a loading button does the same in place. Tonal danger now greys when disabled (component.icon-buttons 1.5.1).

version 1.8.2 (2026-11-10, pair next integration): one number above every claim of this release, 1.7.2 (R074), 1.8.0 (C35) and 1.8.1 (the C36 follow-up), which were built with different contents; nothing beyond the notes above changes. Settings, values, events and keys as the notes above say.

version 1.8.3 (2026-11-11): a patch (docs review R076). theme-cycle under a host that draws the theme itself (the Loader started with theme: false, as a Docara page and its examples are): the name and the icon say the theme the document draws (its theme-dark / theme-light class, else the system scheme) instead of the Loader's untouched light; a press that cannot move the theme says why once in the console (the host owns the theme, or SF.Loader is absent) and still stays put without change. Its shared helper src/smart/helpers/cycle.js changed (module.smart-helpers 1.5.0, unreleased). Nothing drawn differently where the Loader owns the theme; settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.8.4 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-on-disable → --sf-on-surface-disabled. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.8.5 (2026-11-13, a patch, defect BS-1 of ui-control research 2026-11-13-button-schemes, rule C13): a status other than danger -- success, warning, info or any other word -- was dropped without a sound and the scheme colour drawn. It still draws so, and the console says it once per page for each word (helpers/control-status.js, shared with sf-button and sf-menu-context items; error stays the former name of danger). Nothing drawn differently; settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.9.0 (2026-11-11): a minor (owner decision C51). href, target, rel and download: with an href the icon button draws a native <a class="sf-icon-button"> with its look -- the quiet «Скачать <name>» at the end of a table row is a real link to the file, so the browser's own link keys, context menu and download work. The address takes sf-button's rule (a relative address, a fragment, http(s), mailto, tel; any other scheme draws the button); target _blank with no rel says noopener noreferrer; download writes the <a download> name. Disabled or loading, the link has no href, role link and aria-disabled, as sf-button's link; native-type, pressed and a cycle do not apply to a link. component.icon-buttons 1.6.1: a.sf-icon-button takes no link underline. Nothing changes for a button.

version 1.10.0 (2026-11-13; numbered above the integration's 1.9.0): a minor (owner decision C116, the button set, #q-danger-looks; ui-control research 2026-11-13-buttons-system). A danger icon button has three looks -- default (filled), outline and ghost (the icon in a row); tonal, and the retired surface, with status danger are former looks until 2027-01-01 and draw as outline, noted in SF.deprecations and said once per page in the console (helpers/button-set.js, change journal value-button-set-c116). Before, a danger tonal drew the error container fill. danger stays the only status (BS-1 warns on any other word). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. Also in 1.10.0 (2026-11-13, owner decision C118, research R205): the danger outline's border is red -- the error role at the ink family's 64 step, 3.4:1 light and 5.1:1 dark, the same red as its hover plate -- drawn by component.icon-buttons 1.8.0; primary and on-surface outlines keep the shared grey. sf-button-icon is also the arrow part of sf-button's split button (sf-button 1.15.0, C119); its own settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.10.1 (written on fix/c103-inline-button-text as 1.8.4; 2026-11-12, group build 5): a patch, text only, nothing drawn or done differently (decision C103, one line one step). size has words: beside a value in a line of text the button takes the line's step (size="1/2" beside text 1/2: 32, icon 20; size 1 beside text 1: 40, icon 24), in a row of buttons or a field it takes their size, and density moves it with the row. The same note is on sf-button-copy 1.4.1 and the data-sf-copy attribute route.

version 1.11.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C160 (1); research control/research/2026-11-14-tooltip.md, TT-3, TT-11): a minor. The icon button shows its name as a Framework tooltip by itself -- no hand markup and no title: the tooltip controller (component.tooltip, a lazy relation fetched on the first hover, keyboard focus or long press) shows it under a resting pointer after 0.5 s, at once on keyboard focus and among neighbours, on a long press by touch (C59), below the button and flipping above at the window's bottom edge (C160 (4)), one size (C160 (3)), at most two lines (C160 (2)). The text is the name: aria-label, label-pressed while a toggle is on, a cycle's current and next value (which was a browser title); a title the page or a component wrote on the host is the tooltip's text instead and the button carries title="", so no browser tooltip stands over the Framework one (TT-11: sf-language's trigger, sf-settings' close, alert-bar, input-image and the rest keep their markup). A text that repeats the name is not a description (aria-describedby only for a different text). New setting tooltip="off": no tooltip. A button whose page linked its own tooltip (data-tooltip) keeps it. Nothing is drawn before the first hover, focus or long press: first-paint markup unchanged.

version 1.12.0 (2026-11-15; numbered above fix/tooltip-c160 and fix/time-table-c183's 1.11.0): a minor (owner decision C201, study icon-button-plain-study.html#q-icon-plain, variant B1; the name is the owner's, D11e). appearance plain: an icon button with no fill or edge in any state -- hover, press, focus and a pressed toggle included -- whose glyph alone moves: --sf-on-surface-variant at rest, --sf-on-surface under the pointer, --sf-primary on a press (and while a toggle is on). The focus ring is every button's, the hit area the icon button's of the same size. It is for an icon inside another element: a field's action, the help mark at a heading (sf-help-mark 1.5.0), copy in a code block (component.highlight), the plain copy component (component.clipboard). Panels and toolbars keep the looks with a plate; ghost is unchanged. scheme and status do not colour it: a destructive action stays ghost or outline. Drawn by the class sf-icon-button--plain (component.icon-buttons 1.11.0). Other settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.12.1 (written on the branch as 1.12.0; 2026-11-15, fix/dot-avatar-badge-c185): a minor, markup only, nothing drawn differently: the anchored badge holds the Framework's one dot, an .sf-dot after its digits, drawn wherever the badge is a dot (owner decision C185 (8), component.badges 1.9.0). Relation dot added. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.0 (2026-11-16): a minor (2026-11-16; numbered above gb8-record/with-patterns-c57's 1.12.1). RG-IB-1, RG-IB-2 (DEV study actions-icon-buttons-study.html И1, И4, И5) and owner decision C213. Ghost is drawn with sf-icon-button--ghost (link and the retired surface map to ghost and tonal; the class --link is a dated alias of component.icon-buttons 1.14.0); the ghost primary close cross is --sf-primary, as the glyph (it was --sf-primary-active). spacing (and tightness) is retired: an icon button has no density, size and height keep it square; the setting is read, noted in SF.deprecations and said once per button until 2027-01-01 and draws nothing (journal class-icon-button-density-c213); docs drop it from the attribute list.

version 1.13.1 (2026-11-16): a patch. RG-CL-3 (component.icon-buttons 1.15.0, owner decision C14): kind="close" draws as ghost in every appearance (default, tonal, outline were a filled, tonal or outlined square); the template sheet's close rules name every look under the ghost ones. The runtime says it once per button until 2027-01-01.

version 1.13.2 (2026-11-16, owner decision C211 with component.icon-buttons 1.13.0; DEV follow-up msg-ed881173; numbered above 1.13.1 on origin/fix/close-c14-cl1): a patch, text only. The docs and the pressed setting's words say what component.icon-buttons 1.13.0 draws: the pressed look is a toggle's alone (outline or ghost in on-surface or on-surface-variant); a default, tonal, danger or primary icon button keeps its own look with pressed and the console says so once (the tonal toggle looks of 1.6.1 are gone); one choice among several is sf-segmented. Nothing this element draws or does changed.

version 1.13.3 (written on the branch as 1.13.2; 2026-11-16; above 1.13.1 on fix/close-c14-cl1): a patch, nothing drawn changed. Before its name tooltip is made, the button says the tooltip's text as aria-description only when the name does not already say it: a text equal to the name or made of whole words of it (the label «Повторить Отчёт.xlsx», the title «Повторить») is no description. The rule is component.tooltip 1.6.1's, which the tooltip controller applies to aria-describedby once the tooltip is made.

version 1.13.6 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.13.5 on origin/fix/smart-pass-sp1): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

$comment-after: The bundle's former name cl-icon-buttons (the folder was `icon-buttons` until standard
1.3.8 §3, §21 gave it the tag's name) is not a rule here: a rule of type
smart is a Smart component to the registry, and this one has no element. The
Loader forwards it to cl-icon-button from src/core/contracts/

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-icon for a compact action that is unambiguous from one familiar icon and has a concise accessible name.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not omit aria-label when no visible text names the action
Do not use the large-surface radius as a normal control variation
Do not keep a loading action enabled

accessibility.focus: The inner native button is the only focus owner. Pointer activation does not show the ring; keyboard focus uses focus-visible, with an inset ring inside joined controls.

setButtonAttributes.summary: Passes the object to setState() as buttonAttributes; the built-in template does not read it, so it only reaches an external project template. Returns the element.

onClick.summary: Adds a listener for click on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseEnter.summary: Adds a listener for mouseenter on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseLeave.summary: Adds a listener for mouseleave on the host. Returns the element.

setDisabled.summary: Sets the disabled attribute when nextValue is truthy and removes it otherwise. Returns the element.

root-class.description: Extra classes applied to the inner icon button element.
